primary_policy: U=.25,local linear monotone crossing; d3 minimumN6,d4 minimumN10. Uniform d4 minimum chosen after pilot inspection, not preregistered. Fits remain conditional.
errorbar_policy: Dark bars conditional MC95; light bars union of conditional MC95 across tested thresholds .20/.25/.30,linear/PCHIP,size cuts,correction models,and provided cut/block snapshots. Include rejected diagnostic variants; union is descriptive, not a total confidence interval.
scope: D3/D4 only. D2 deferred; d5 disabled. Neighboring zero-beta slices unresolved rather than inferred absent from missing quarter crossing.
